metadata.scope: One editor, normal club sessions; no concurrent-session capacity claim
metadata.narrowViewport: 390x844 Chromium viewport; desktop hardware, no mobile CPU/network emulation
metadata.cpuNote: 1ms inspector sampling; includes untimed fixture setup/warmup/assertions; hot-function shares are diagnostic
metadata.browserNote: Final core-action readiness is recorded by an in-page DOM observer in domDesktop/domNarrow, with 10 observations per action and viewport. The older desktop/narrow statistics include driver visibility polling and are retained as diagnostic upper bounds. Pending feedback is a DOM signal, not paint/INP. Full Flight completion is separate; final persisted state was checked independently. Ambiguous ancillary DOM markers are excluded.
metadata.percentileNote: Stored nearest-rank p95s are exploratory. Older driver samples have 30 observations across three sessions; final in-page DOM samples have only 10 per viewport, so their p95 is not used as a reliability estimate.
metadata.queryNote: Outstanding-query union includes pool/connection/network/Postgres; category sums overlap and must not be added to request duration
